text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. Taupe asymmetric one-shoulder draped chiffon top with long sheer side panels, ivory high-waist flowing wide trousers, cream open-toe heels.。仅服装与鞋袜；无可拆卸配饰。
original_prompt: Edit this exact wardrobe catalog image. Remove toes from open-toe heels; empty footwear only. Preserve all garment design, colors, arrangement and white background. No skin, toes, hands, human body, mannequin or anatomy anywhere. Empty shoes with clearly visible empty interior footbeds; white background through any openings. Hollow garments only. Do not introduce accessories or change clothing.
